title: Host-only expiring header credential source v1

x-runtime-contract.capability_scope: Configured per-app native host support; not current credential freshness. No guest ABI change.
x-runtime-contract.file: One atomic JSON envelope, at most 8192 bytes; absolute operator-admitted path; no-follow same-descriptor regular-file read; Unix effective UID ownership and exact 0600 permissions.
x-runtime-contract.reference: Must exactly equal the existing credential.reference authority.
x-runtime-contract.expiry: Trusted provider expiry in UTC Unix milliseconds, never guessed from JWT contents. Require expiry strictly greater than ceil(wall_time_ms) + ceil(remaining_attempt_budget_ms) + safety_margin_ms. Invalid/nonpositive clocks, expired deadlines and arithmetic overflow fail closed. Trusted host UTC synchronization is required; arbitrary clock skew cannot be inferred.
x-runtime-contract.header: Complete printable ASCII header value, at most 4096 bytes. Producer supplies Bearer exactly once; runtime adds no prefix. Duplicate or unknown envelope fields are rejected.
x-runtime-contract.connection_gates: Provider WebSocket Open before handle allocation; worker before dial; fresh read after TLS before authentication. HTTP v1/v2 before operation allocation and fresh read before sending with the full remaining attempt deadline, including retries.
x-runtime-contract.lifetime: New connection/request authentication only; existing WebSockets are not retroactively closed.
x-runtime-contract.identity: Bind source kind, safety margin, fixed path/reference and destination through existing credential policy identity. Never fingerprint rotating values, generations or expiry, and never read files during identity/capability discovery.
x-runtime-contract.writer: Publish a complete private temporary file by atomic rename. A stable separate writer flock must cover publication and compare-current-generation/unlink cleanup; locking the rotating inode or comparing outside the lock is insufficient. Runtime never unlinks a source.
x-runtime-contract.legacy: Omitted source retains byte-identical raw-file serialization/identity and legacy raw-header behavior. Null, unknown and unsupported sources are rejected.
